info.title: Rhythm session adapter
info.description: Session contract v1. All protected responses are no-store. HTTPS is mandatory outside local development. Keys are independent session-scoped capabilities, not proof of game authenticity. Legacy /api/chat and /api/results are separate and not described here. Default lifetime 24 hours; cleanup removes payloads after expiry/revocation and session metadata within the following 24 hours, retaining an ID-only non-reversible anti-reuse tombstone. QR landing requires operator confirmation of external-log redaction. Rate limits are per running app instance; use one instance or an external distributed limiter.
